Better SFX by video2ctx

All sounds

Free sound effects for video

Short, clean sound effects for video edits: whooshes for cuts, clicks and typing for screen recordings, pops for titles and real-world foley. Every file is trimmed to start on the sound and matched in loudness, so it drops onto the timeline without cleanup. They are free for monetized videos, and nobody may register them with YouTube Content ID.

  • Put a whoosh slightly before a cut, so its loudest moment lands on the new shot.
  • In a screen recording, place a click or key press on the frame where the cursor or key makes contact.
  • Keep effects 6 to 12 dB under the voice-over, so they support the edit instead of covering it.
